== Notes ==

* While under the effect of this skill, attacks with a bow will deal [[Armor-respecting damage|armor-respecting]] fire damage to all foes in an area adjacent to the landing area of each shot arrow, before the arrow itself hits.
** The explosion occurs regardless of whether the arrow actually hits its target (even if it [[miss]]es, [[stray]]s or is [[block]]ed).
** Multiple-arrow attacks ([[Dual Shot]], [[Forked Arrow]], [[Triple Shot]] and [[Incendiary Arrows]]) will trigger an explosion for each arrow.
** The fact that the explosion triggers first is relevant for skills such as [[Reversal of Fortune]] or [[Reversal of Damage]].
** Unlike [[Kindle Arrows]], the [[damage type]] of the arrows is not converted to [[fire damage|fire]], thus it will not be enough to meet the condition of [[Conjure Flame]]'s bonus damage. 
** The explosion itself is not an attack. The damage will not be increased by effects increasing the damage of attacks such as modifiers on the bow or skills like [[Ursan Roar]] or [["Together as One!"]]. However it is increased by [[Ebon Battle Standard of Honor]].
** The fire damage can be used to trigger [[burning]] on foes hexed with [[Mark of Rodgort]].
